page.notes: The page opens mid-paragraph, so the first paragraph is marked cont="true". The quotation runs over the page break and ends with the broken word "tan-" / "dem". The printed quotation marks appear at the start of every line of the quotation; I have given one opening mark. Doubtful readings: "Monfortius" (the second letter could be an o or n, and I could not confirm the form), and "VIII" (the numeral is printed in a broken form, read here as VIII). The long s has been written as plain s throughout, including in "sicca" and "sanguine", which the printer's long s makes look like "ficca" and "fanguine".
